news.title: Meeting students where they are: A holistic approach to higher-ed mental health
news.summary_en: Academic pressures, financial uncertainty, growing personal responsibilities at home, and a rapidly changing social and political landscape are fueling concerns and apprehensions in the daily lives of college students.

news.title: Why one-off AI training will not prepare teachers
news.summary_en: Across K–12 education, districts are moving quickly to help teachers understand artificial intelligence. They are offering workshops, creating guidance, identifying approved tools and developing resources to support responsible use.
